chapter: Al Hibbler, Dakota Staton and later years
title: A hot-rod crash on the rainy Pennsylvania Turnpike
summary: A speeding car with 'Wendy' on the back skids across the median and hits a Mercedes, its engine rolling into Malachi's car.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Anyway, we were driving, and we drove all that night. And on the Pennsylvania Turnpike the next day, there was a downpour of rain like the typical summer rain. I think the

speed limit on the Turnpike then was 65, and I think I was doing about 50, which I think was kind of fast in that kind of weather, but there were a lot of other cars which were driving much faster. It was really one of those downpours, with the thunder and lightning and everything. So I think I'm driving at a moderate speed, the speed limit being 65, and all of a sudden, this car zoomed past me, and all I could see was on the back of it... It was the kind of car that back in those days they called hot rods, that youngsters, teenagers or young men used to make, and they made a lot of noise and looked pretty slick. This car had "Wendy" written on the back of it. And it passed me and took off, and I said, just saying to myself, "Boy, this guy must really know these Pennsylvania hills up here, the way he's driving."

Anyway, he passed me, and he meant to make a turn to get into the right lane in front of me. And when he did, he must have turned the car too quickly or something, because the car skidded and headed towards this embankment. Well, the Pennsylvania Turnpike is really a mountain... I think there's hills and mountains all the way on it. And there's nothing but a guard rail over there, sometimes that keeps you from falling 50 or 60 feet down. So he's heading towards this guard rail, then he panics and he turns it the other way, to the left. So when he turned it to the left, the car skidded

and shot across the strip between... They had a grass median thing in between the two highways. When he did, he shot across this grass thing onto the oncoming cars on the other side. Ran head on into a guy who was driving a Mercedes-Benz. He hit that car, threw himself out of the windshield, I guess for at least 10 feet. The other car just went aways and came to a halt. And the whole engine flew out of his car and started rolling back across the highways towards me. I managed to pull over enough so it just hit the side of my car, the car I was driving, and tore the left tire off and the fender and everything.
